correctness.rationale: For each subset I of r=k-1 square arms, deletion of the hub separates relative faces with exactly r distal vertices and at most one of the two neighbors per selected arm. The relative closed ball is Δ^{r-1}*(S^0)^{*r}, of dimension 2r−1, and its boundary is contained in the link. Relative oriented top cycles z_I with alternating leaf choices give a primitive integral basis. Two block reorderings cancel, so arm permutations have positive subset sign; each within-arm flip acts by −1 exactly when selected. Trace coefficient, vanishing invariants, and Z/2 coinvariants follow. For r>m the link equals deletion and the complex is a cone. This reconstructs C without conflating relative balls and an independent novelty result.
